descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A2 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Status and errors are not announced: errors, 'no results', Ask AI answers and 'Listening…' are silent for screen readers; toggles expose no selected/pressed state

Tickets: TFA-94745 etc. · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-15/S19, TC-23/S18, TC-09/S23

Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S22 Failure and offline states pass axe and are announced

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • T2 Each error tells the physician what to do next (retry, check connection, enable permission, sign in) in plain language in the app's existing style (TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 1)
  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear 'no network' message; dictation kept and retried when the connection returns, so dropped hospital Wi-Fi does not lose a physician's dictation (UAT Empty & Failure States (Offline / no network); UAT OAT-03 Source; TFA-94745 state 9)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane with each state on screen: generation failure (both contexts), billing retry button, Ask AI error, no-network banner, scan error

When Run axe on each state

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the message sits in a status or alert region so a screen reader hears it; the retry control is a named button reachable by keyboard

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core: zero serious/critical; role=status or role=alert on the message container (ConnectionBanner already renders role="status"); keyboard Tab reaches the retry

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94422 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

The scan error 'The photo couldn't be read…' is not announced to screen readers in either mode, and these failure screens have serious contrast failures.

Evidence: allure 2c3f0815-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/OAT-03_S22: 85 checks pass, 30 fail. Generation-failure, billing, Ask AI and offline messages are in role=alert/status, and the retry buttons are named and reached by Tab (desktop, Pixel 7). The scan-error part is the same defect as in EFS/S22 (counted there too). Recorded only: a 'Chart access couldn't be recorded' banner appeared once in the pre-review run under shared-stack load; it is likely a test-environment artifact and is unconfirmed.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: visual.

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S22

Failure and offline states pass axe and are announced

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane visual: status failed in visual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: yes): failure.spec.ts: generation failure (both contexts), billing retry (Hospital), Ask AI error (both), scan error (both) and the offline banner; axe serious/critical = 0, message in role=alert/status, retry is a named button reached by Tab (desktop, Pixel 7). [2026-10-14 review] Generate is pressed in the generation-failure states: ai/notes:generateNote is answered 'fail' at the socket, so nothing reaches the backend and no model is called. — All socket-injected; keyboard reach not checked on iPhone WebKit (Tab skips buttons by default) and recorded so.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 85 judged check(s) passed, 30 failed. Generation failure (both), billing retry (Hospital), Ask AI error (both), scan error (both), offline banner: failure messages in role=alert/status except the scan error; retry controls are named buttons reached by Tab on desktop and Pixel 7 (not checked on iPhone WebKit, recorded). Generate is pressed in the generation-failure states with ai/notes:generateNote answered 'fail' at the socket (no model call).

Product issue: The scan failure 'The photo couldn’t be read. Check your connection and try again, or retake the photo.' is not announced (no role=alert/status) in either context; plus serious contrast failures on these screens (oracle: zero serious/critical, message in a status or alert region).

Recorded-only cells (recorded): Pre-review run only (iterations/pre-review/evidence/OAT-03_S22/desktop--nh-scan-error.json): a red 'Chart access couldn’t be recorded. Check your connection and reload.' banner was on screen once, with nothing deleted, while the shared local backend was under other jobs' load; not seen in the post-review run on any profile. Likely the access-log mutation timing out under load (a test-environment artifact), unconfirmed.

Evidence: 7 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/OAT-03_S22 — a folder (51 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and the failure states are forced with socket failFirst, setOffline and a scan fixture; make-session.ts refuses dev and dev has no action mock, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
